steps.message:
Implement rejected_trial_label(summary, receipt) in scripts/observe_review.py for Observatory's campaign detail. The caller has already verified the receipt's digest, task, seed and strict boolean acceptance fields and determined the overall trial was rejected. Only return a display string. No file access or side effects.

Show "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout" for the Tinfield shape: source_accepted true and handoff_accepted false, final_handoff explicitly null, clean_agent_completion explicitly false, and agent_error recording type DeadlineExceeded and message "Whole-stage wall deadline expired". A missing field, malformed agent_error, different error (including token or tool budgets), or a recorded terminal submission must not be inferred to be that timeout. A bound agent_outcome with exit_status Submitted or Blocked is a terminal disposition. For other accepted-source/rejected-handoff cases show "source accepted / handoff rejected". If the source was rejected, show "source rejected / handoff accepted" or "source and handoff rejected" according to the receipt. If both dimensions passed but the run failed overall, show "trial failed / source and handoff accepted". Evidence from the receipt determines dimensions; ignore prose findings. Older summaries may omit terminal evidence. Edit only scripts/observe_review.py. Check representative cases offline.

## Edit scope

Only the listed paths may be added, modified, or deleted; no other file changes are accepted.

- editable: scripts/observe_review.py

All other supplied files are read-only.

cat > /tmp/check_label.py <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/scripts")
from observe_review import rejected_trial_label

TIMEOUT = {"type": "DeadlineExceeded", "message": "Whole-stage wall deadline expired"}

def tinfield(**over):
    r = {
        "source_accepted": True,
        "handoff_accepted": False,
        "final_handoff": None,
        "clean_agent_completion": False,
        "agent_error": dict(TIMEOUT),
    }
    r.update(over)
    return r

cases = [
    ("tinfield canonical", {"findings": "agent ran out of wall time"}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout"),
    ("tinfield, no agent_outcome key (older record)", {}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout"),
    ("tinfield, agent_outcome null", {"agent_outcome": None}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout"),
    ("terminal submission -> not timeout", {"agent_outcome": {"exit_status": "Submitted"}}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("terminal blocked -> not timeout", {"agent_outcome": {"exit_status": "Blocked"}}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("terminal evidence in receipt", {}, {**tinfield(), "agent_outcome": {"exit_status": "Submitted"}},
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("exit_status Failed is not terminal", {"agent_outcome": {"exit_status": "Failed"}}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout"),
    ("exit_status lowercase not terminal", {"agent_outcome": {"exit_status": "submitted"}}, tinfield(),
     "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout"),
    ("final_handoff missing -> not timeout", {}, {k: v for k, v in tinfield().items() if k != "final_handoff"},
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("final_handoff not null -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(final_handoff={"doc": "x"}),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("clean_agent_completion missing -> not timeout", {}, {k: v for k, v in tinfield().items() if k != "clean_agent_completion"},
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("clean_agent_completion true -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(clean_agent_completion=True),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("agent_error missing -> not timeout", {}, {k: v for k, v in tinfield().items() if k != "agent_error"},
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("agent_error null -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(agent_error=None),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("agent_error malformed (string) -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(agent_error="DeadlineExceeded"),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("agent_error missing message -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(agent_error={"type": "DeadlineExceeded"}),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("token budget error -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(agent_error={"type": "TokenBudgetExceeded", "message": "Whole-stage wall deadline expired"}),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("tool budget error -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(agent_error={"type": "DeadlineExceeded", "message": "Tool budget exhausted"}),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("different message -> not timeout", {}, tinfield(agent_error={"type": "DeadlineExceeded", "message": "wall deadline expired"}),
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("plain accepted/rejected", {"findings": "handoff doc invalid"}, {"source_accepted": True, "handoff_accepted": False},
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("source rejected / handoff accepted", {}, {"source_accepted": False, "handoff_accepted": True},
     "source rejected / handoff accepted"),
    ("both rejected", {}, {"source_accepted": False, "handoff_accepted": False},
     "source and handoff rejected"),
    ("both accepted, overall failed", {}, {"source_accepted": True, "handoff_accepted": True},
     "trial failed / source and handoff accepted"),
    ("prose ignored: receipt dims win", {"source_accepted": False, "handoff_accepted": True, "findings": "source was rejected"},
     {"source_accepted": True, "handoff_accepted": False},
     "source accepted / handoff rejected"),
    ("summary-only dims (receipt lacks booleans)", {"source_accepted": True, "handoff_accepted": False,
     "final_handoff": None, "clean_agent_completion": False, "agent_error": dict(TIMEOUT)}, {},
     "source accepted / handoff missing at timeout"),
    ("non-bool truthy ignored", {}, {"source_accepted": 1, "handoff_accepted": 0},
     "source and handoff rejected"),
    ("receipt not a dict", {}, None, "source and handoff rejected"),
    ("both None", None, None, "source and handoff rejected"),
]

fails = 0
for name, summary, receipt, expected in cases:
    got = rejected_trial_label(summary, receipt)
    ok = got == expected
    fails += 0 if ok else 1
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"), name, "->", got, ("" if ok else f"(expected {expected})"))

r = tinfield()
assert rejected_trial_label({}, r) == rejected_trial_label({}, r)
print("TOTAL FAILS:", fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
EOF
python3 /tmp/check_label.py
